name: StudyBuddy
tagline: An iOS study tracker that logs hours and suggests better study plans.
problem: Students struggle to balance courses and use study time well.
solution: A SwiftUI app logs study sessions and analyses them to optimize plans, with collaborative features.
demo_moment: Team-described: log a session and see your plan update.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Community Building Hack” and “Swift Student Challenge from Apple” among 134 submissions.
First-time hackathon team learned Swift at a workshop during the event.

lessons: Learning the sponsor's stack at its own workshop can win its prize.
